programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Pups Save a Hum-Kicker; Pups Save the One-Man Band
programs.desc: Mayor Humdinger turns up the power on his robotic soccer cleats, the "Hum-Kickers", and starts wrecking the town; Francois causes musical mayhem, as a one-man band, when he plans a special song for Wally's birthday.

programs.title: Mr. Crocodile
programs.desc: Daisy and Mr. Crocodile assume Gigi is lonely and try to spend every minute with her; Mr. Crocodile hides Teddy's stuffed animal during hide and seek, but then can't find it anywhere.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Pups Save an Antarctic Martian; Pups Save the Maze Explorers
programs.desc: Travelling Travis is on another great adventure when he lands in Antarctica but believes he's actually on Mars; Mr. Porter and Alex go on a sightseeing hike but get trapped inside a huge maze.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Mighty Pups Charged Up: Pups vs. Three Super Baddies
programs.desc: Super baddies Harold, Ladybird and the Copycat team up and take the Mighty Pups' mighty meteor; the Mighty Pups must get their meteor back and charge up to stop them before the team of baddies destroys Adventure Bay.

programs.title: Rubble & Crew
programs.sub_title: The Crew Builds a Popcorn Café; The Crew Fixes a Slippery Mess
programs.desc: The crew switches to cleanup mode when construction on Café Carl's new popcorn restaurant pops out of control; a soapy accident causes slippery mayhem all over Builder Cove.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Air Rescue: Pups Save the Airport Opening
programs.desc: Adventure Bay is getting a new airport! Sweetie tries to take the Princess' place at the grand opening.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Pups Save a Tour Bus; Pups Save Midnight at the Museum
programs.desc: Mayor Humdinger's tour bus goes out of control when he tries to bring tourists to Foggy Bottom; a fun museum sleepover is interrupted when Alex and the mini-patrol go missing, and Mayor Goodway gets stranded on a T. rex.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Dancing With Luke Stars; Pups Save a Mischievous Octopus
programs.desc: A dance contest being judged by Luke Stars goes wrong when a floating dance floor carries the contestants away; the pups investigate a mystery at an undersea-themed museum exhibit and discover an octopus that wants to return to the ocean.

programs.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programs.sub_title: The Krusty Bucket; Squid's on a Bus
programs.desc: Plankton creates a clone of himself and Mr. Krabs, but neither restaurant is safe from the newcomer; Squidward gleefully switches jobs with a bus driver for an easy ride, until SpongeBob and Patrick climb aboard.

programs.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programs.desc: Mr. Krabs hires Squidward to babysit Pearl for the night, but she just wants to sneak out to a cool teen party; after spilling a milkshake during a delivery, SpongeBob vows to return and clean the entire building.

programs.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programs.desc: The friends become unstoppable after Sandy teaches them karate; before long, the entire town learns the martial art and joins the action.

programs.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programs.sub_title: Kiss of the Nematode; Brainless Bawn
programs.desc: A square yellow sponge named SpongeBob SquarePants lives in a pineapple with his pet snail, Gary, in the city of Bikini Bottom on the floor of the Pacific Ocean.
